text:
Samir Desai: Heads-up 12: invoice INV-2026-412 for Nimbus Labs (acct NB-1102) shows PROMO-AUTO-SCALE applied to reserved capacity lines. That promo should have only covered autoscale overages (burst). Customer is asking for a goodwill adjustment. Invoice total moved from $9,400 to $4,400 after promo 12:confused:

Rosa Martinez: I pulled the billing export. Promo landed on two reserved rows (reserved-8g-x2) instead of the burst rows (burst-overage). Looks like rule mapping failed when we expanded autoscale SKUs last month.

Theo Grant: Oof. This is the autoscale SKU rename bug we patched in infra but apparently billing rule mapping didn't get the new tag. We should either reassign promo lines on the invoice or issue a credit memo. Customer prefers invoice edit if possible.

Evelyn Park: How much credit are we talking about? Also need rationale for internal audit.

Samir Desai: Amount that needs to be reversed from reserved to burst = $5,000. Customer asks we not refund cash; they'd like invoice corrected and a credit memo applied. They flagged this for renewal discussion, so handle as goodwill.

Rosa Martinez: Accounting path: create CM-2026-099 for $5,000, apply to INV-2026-412, and post journal. Proposed journal: 
```
Date: 2026-06-10
Debit: Promo Expense (GL 7205)    $5,000
Credit: Accounts Receivable       $5,000
Memo: Move misplaced PROMO-AUTO-SCALE from reserved capacity to burst overage for INV-2026-412 (NB-1102)
```

Theo Grant: Please add internal tag "billing-mapping-bug" and link to infra PR that did SKU rename. Also route to eng-billing for a validation test to prevent future mis-mapping.

Evelyn Park: Approved as goodwill, no cash refund. @Samir create CM-2026-099 and include approver note "approved by E. Park 2026-06-10". Rosa: please attach CSV export and the original invoice PDF.

billing-bot: CM-2026-099 issued and attached to INV-2026-412. Journal JNL-99120 created.

Samir Desai: Notified Nimbus Labs via support ticket and CSM. Added internal follow-up: ENG TICKET EB-78 to add a unit test for promo mapping when SKU aliases change.

Rosa Martinez: Closing loop here. Finance will reconcile CM in this month's close. Filing a small retro note for renewals team to mention the goodwill concession on the renewal quote.

Evelyn Park: Thanks everyone. Let's monitor for any other invoices that used PROMO-AUTO-SCALE this billing cycle; Rosa, can you run a quick search and ping if >1 affected?

Rosa Martinez: On it 12: running search now; will post results in this thread if I find others.
